mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 5.5% indicates a tightening labor market that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 5.5%), or t-test p-value > 0.05 for return difference vs. baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signal robust consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 105), a monthly decline in industrial output signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 105 and INDPRO declines, or t-test p-value > 0.05 for return difference vs. non-declining INDPRO periods.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 270.0 indicates elevated inflation that triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 270.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher retail sales (RSAFS) relative to the previous month indicates sustained consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 indicates a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or t-test p-value > 0.05 for return difference vs. non-contracting INDPRO periods.
